text: Foster carer. Boy, 22 months, temp 38.1. He has dark spots that don't fade when I press a glass on them. His skin is very dark so I checked his palms, the soles of his feet and inside his lower eyelids, and the marks are there too. He also won't bend his head forward. If I try to get him to look down at his tummy he refuses and holds his neck stiff. Breathing is normal. Tell me straight what I need to do.
